home.aboutTitle: Soo ogow Waxa Ugu Fiican Hargeysa
home.aboutDescription1: Go Hargeisa waa madal casri ah oo hagta dalxiiska iyo magaalada Hargeysa, Somaliland. Waxay ka caawisaa booqdayaasha iyo dadka deegaanka inay si fudud u helaan hudheello, maqaayado, kafateeriyo, goobaha dalxiiska, xarumaha wax iibsiga iyo ganacsiyada deegaanka.
home.aboutDescription2: Samee akoon bilaash ah si aad u kaydiso meelaha aad jeceshahay, u qorto faallooyin, u maamusho xogtaada, una habayso khibraddaada safarka. Gelitaanka Google waxaa loo isticmaalaa oo keliya aqoonsi ammaan ah iyo isku waafajinta xogtaada qalab kasta.

about.title: Ku Saabsan Go Hargeisa
about.paragraph1: Go Hargeisa waa hage dalxiis oo madax-bannaan loo dhisay si loogu soo bandhigo Hargeysa — caasimadda Somaliland — booqdayaasha caalamiga ah, safarayaasha ganacsiga, iyo shirkooyinka Soomaalida ee adduunka oo dhan.
about.paragraph2: Waxaan la shaqeynaa hudheellada, maqaayadaha, hagayaasha, iyo machadyada dhaqanka ee maxalliga ah si aan u hayno liistooyinkeena oo sax ah, cusub, oo waxtar dhab ah leh, hadday tahay inaad qorsheynayso booqashadaada ugu horreysa ama aad raadinayso kafateeriya cusub oo aad jeceshahay oo kuu dhow.
about.paragraph3: Ma haysaa ganacsi aad rabto in la liistoyo, mise waxaad aragtay macluumaad aan la cusboonaysiin? Nala soo xiriir <link>bogga xiriirka</link> — waan ku faraxsanahay inaan ka maqalno.

privacy.title: Siyaasadda Asturnaanta
privacy.lastUpdated: Markii ugu dambeysay ee la cusboonaysiiyay: Luulyo 2026
privacy.intro: Go Hargeisa ("annaga") waxay ixtiraamtaa asturnaantaada. Boggan wuxuu sharraxayaa macluumaadka aan ururino markaad isticmaasho boggan iyo sida loo isticmaalo.
privacy.infoItem1: Macluumaadka akoonka (magaca, iimaylka) marka aad isdiiwaangeliso.
privacy.infoItem2: Faallooyinka, waxyaabaha la jecel yahay, iyo safarrada la kaydiyay ee aad samaysid intaad gashan tahay.
privacy.infoItem3: Cinwaannada iimaylka ee ku biiray warsidaha.
privacy.infoItem4: Xog aasaasi ah oo isticmaal ah oo naga caawisa horumarinta boggan.
privacy.useText: Waxaan macluumaadkaaga u isticmaalnaa oo keliya si aan u maamulno Go Hargeisa — u gaar yeelidda dashboard-kaaga, u dirista warsidaha aad ku biirtay, iyo ka jawaabidda foomka xiriirka. Xogta shakhsiga ah ma iibinno.
privacy.contactText: Su'aalaha ku saabsan siyaasaddan waxaa loo diri karaa hello@gohargeisa.com.

terms.title: Shuruudaha Adeegga
terms.lastUpdated: Markii ugu dambeysay ee la cusboonaysiiyay: Luulyo 2026
terms.intro: Adigoo isticmaalaya Go Hargeisa, waxaad ku oggolaataa shuruudaha soo socda. Fadlan si taxaddar leh u akhri.
terms.useOfContentText: Macluumaadka liistada (hudheellada, maqaayadaha, goobaha dalxiiska, dhacdooyinka) waxaa loo bixiyaa ujeeddooyin guud oo qorshaynta safarka ah. Qiimayaasha, saacadaha, iyo heli karista waa in lagu xaqiijiyaa si toos ah ganacsiga ka hor buugsiga.
terms.userAccountsText: Waxaad mas'uul ka tahay ilaalinta qarsoodiga xogta akoonkaaga iyo dhaqan kasta oo ka dhaca akoonkaaga. Faallooyinka aad soo gudbiso waa inay ahaadaan kuwo daacad ah oo ku salaysan khibrad dhab ah.
terms.liabilityText: Go Hargeisa waxaa la bixiyaa "sida ay tahay" iyada oo aan la bixin dammaanad nooc kasta ah. Mas'uul kama nihin khasaaraha ka dhasha ku tiirsanaanta macluumaadka laga helo boggan.
terms.contactText: Su'aalaha ku saabsan shuruudahan waxaa loo diri karaa hello@gohargeisa.com.

travelGuide.title: Hagaha Safarka ee Hargeysa
travelGuide.subtitle: Macluumaad wax ku ool ah oo kaa caawinaya inaad qorsheyso safar fudud
travelGuide.visaBody: Dad badan ayaa heli kara fiisaha Somaliland marka ay ku soo gaaraan Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Caalamiga ah ee Egal (HGA), ama horay uga hesho xafiiska matalaadda Somaliland ee dibadda. La socorso laba sawir oo baasaboor ah oo bixi lacagta dollar Mareykan ah.
travelGuide.airportBody: Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Caalamiga ah ee Egal (HGA) wuxuu ka fog yahay ilaa 5 km bartamaha magaalada. Taksiyada iyo gaadiidka hudheellada ayaa laga heli karaa dibadda gelitaanka; kala heshii kirada intaadan bixin.
travelGuide.transportBody: Taksiyada la wadaago iyo kuwa gaarka ah ayaa ah habka ugu badan ee lagu socon karo magaalada. Aplikeeshannada gaariga raadinta ayaa xaddidan, sidaas darteed hudheelladu waxay diyaarin karaan darawallo la aamini karo oo loogu talagalay safarrada maalinlaha ah iyo geynta garoonka.
travelGuide.currencyBody: Shilinka Somaliland (SLSH) ayaa ah lacagta maxalliga ah, in kastoo dollarka Mareykanka si weyn loo aqbalo hudheellada, iibsiga waaweyn, iyo taksiyada. Lacagta mobilada (Zaad, eDahab) ayaa la isticmaalaa meel kasta, xitaa dukaammada yaryar.
travelGuide.safetyBody: Hargeysa guud ahaan waa ammaan booqdayaasha qaata taxaddarrada caadiga ah. Xidho dhar edeb leh, ka fogow in aad sawirto dhismayaasha dawladda ama millatariga, oo maxalli ahaan hubi tilmaamaha nabadgelyada ugu dambeeya safarka ka hor.
travelGuide.emergencyBody: Booliska: 999 · Isbitaalka Kooxda Hargeysa: waxaa laga heli karaa miiska soo dhaweynta hudheelka · Had iyo jeer wado cinwaanka iyo lambarka taleefanka hudheelkaaga.
travelGuide.internetBody: Kaararka SIM ee maxalliga ah (Telesom, Somtel) way jaban yihiin oo si fudud loogu iibsan karaa baasaboor. Daboolka xogtu wuu adag yahay bartamaha magaalada; inta badan hudheellada iyo kafateeriyaduba waxay sidoo kale bixiyaan WiFi.
travelGuide.customsBody: Somaliland waa bulsho Muslim ah oo dhaqameed. Xidho dhar edeb leh, ku salaam gacanta midig, kana filo in Jimcaha ay tahay maalin nasasho oo ganacsiyo badan.
travelGuide.bestTimeBody: Bisha Nofembar ilaa Febraayo ayaa bixisa cimilada ugu qaboow oo ugu raaxada badan. Xilliga roobabka (Abriil–Maajo) ayaa ka dhigi kara safarka magaalada dibadeeda mid adag.
travelGuide.packingBody: Dhar fudud oo edeb leh (waxaa lagula talinayaa gacmo dhaadheer iyo surwaal/goono dhaadheer), shaal haweenka, kabo lagu socon karo oo raaxo leh, ilaalin qorraxda, iyo kaydka koronto ee caalamiga ah.
travelGuide.faq1Q: Ma u baahanahay fiisa si aan u booqdo Hargeysa?
travelGuide.faq1A: Inta badan safarayaasha waxay heli karaan fiisaha Somaliland marka ay garoonka diyaaradaha yimaadaan, laakiin waxaa fiican in la hubiyo shuruudaha hadda jira ee jinsiyaddaada intaadan duulin.
travelGuide.faq2Q: Ma ammaan bay u tahay booqdayaasha Hargeysa?
travelGuide.faq2A: Hargeysa waxaa loo tixgeliyaa mid ka mid ah magaalooyinka ugu deggan oo ugu soo dhaweeya gobolka, laakiin sida meel kasta oo la booqdo, waxaa caqli gal ah in la sii socdo warbixinnada oo la qaato taxaddarro caqli gal ah.
travelGuide.faq3Q: Luqad noocee ah ayaa lagu hadlaa Hargeysa?
travelGuide.faq3A: Af-Soomaaliga ayaa ah luqadda ugu horreysa, iyadoo Carabiga iyo Ingiriisiga sidoo kale si weyn loo fahmo, gaar ahaan hudheellada iyo dadka da'da yar.

transportation.title: Gaadiidka
transportation.subtitle: Sida loogu socdo Hargeysa si raaxo iyo ammaan leh
transportation.airportTransfersBody: Garoonka Diyaaradaha ee Caalamiga ah ee Egal (HGA) wuxuu ka fog yahay ilaa 5 km bartamaha magaalada. Inta badan hudheellada waxay diyaarin karaan qaadid; taksiyada garoonka diyaaradahana si fudud ayaa loo heli karaa.
transportation.taxisBody: Habka ugu badan ee lagu socon karo. Kala heshii kirada intaadan fuulin, ama waydii hudheelkaaga inuu kuu buugsado darawal la aamini karo.
transportation.minibusesBody: Baabuurta yaryar ee la wadaago waxay mareeyaan waddooyin go'an oo magaalada oo dhan, waana ikhtiyaarka ugu jaban, in kastoo jadwalladu aysan rasmi ahayn.
transportation.rentalBody: Kirada baabuurta ee is-wadidda ah way yar tahay; inta badan booqdayaashu waxay kiraystaan baabuur darawal leh oo loogu talagalay safarrada maalinlaha ah ee magaalada dibaddeeda, oo lagu qabsado hudheellada ama shirkadaha dalxiiska.
